items.title: The US DOJ indicts three foreign nationals for allegedly using AI to impersonate CEOs and attorneys…
items.text: The US DOJ indicts three foreign nationals for allegedly using AI to impersonate CEOs and attorneys at major international law firms in a $129M+ fraud scheme. Federal prosecutors say the suspects posed as corporate executives and high-powered attorneys, using AI to convince employees to transfer millions of dollars.

items.text: Employees at Microsoft, long known for its stability, are grappling with its decision to offer buyouts to 60,000 people as its spending priorities shift to AI. Within an hour of Microsoft's announcement of buyouts last week, employees rushed to an internal site to see whether they had been offered one.
